title: Go Birds! Radio, Part 1: It's Sean Mannion Time
text: James Seltzer and Eliot Shorr-Parks discuss their expectations for Eagles offensive coordinator one day before the team's season opener in the first hour of their radio show. Presented by Ashley, America's number one furniture and mattress store.

title: Go Birds! Radio, Part 2: NFL Expert Predicts Good Things For Jalen Hurts
text: James Seltzer and Eliot Shorr-Parks react to a rather positive prediction from an NFL expert on Jalen Hurts' 2026 season. Presented by Ashley, America's number one furniture and mattress store.
